description:
Set up a nonprofit organization on Kindora from a brief you wrote about it, when the person
asks for that.

Write the brief from the conversation: who wrote it (assistant.name), the organization
(name, plus website or EIN), its mission in its own words, programs, what it is raising for,
and the person's name and role. The brief's fields are in this tool's input schema.
Before calling, show the person the whole brief, say it will be sent to Kindora along with
their email address, and ask whether to send it. Call only after they say yes, with
`person_approved_sending` set to true. Put anything they do not want on the profile in
`keep_private`.

This tool writes: Kindora records the request and emails the person a link. It returns no
link. The person confirms their email with a six-digit code and reviews every field before
a profile is created.

brief.description: A brief about one organization, written by an assistant for the person to review before Kindora sets it up.

name.description: The assistant that wrote the brief, e.g. "Claude". The email names it.

funding.description: What the organization is raising for.

current_funders.description: Funders that fund the organization now, by name.

how_it_is_going.description: Recent progress, in the person's words.

keep_private.description: Context the person does not want on the profile. It is never shown on the profile.

locale.description: Language of the email and the review page.

mission.description: The mission in the organization's own words; at least 50 characters to count toward funder matching.

countries.description: Two-letter ISO codes of the countries it works in.

ein.description: US EIN, nine digits (a dash is fine). This or website is required.

fiscal_sponsor_name.description: The fiscal sponsor, when entity is fiscally_sponsored.

us_states.description: Two-letter codes of the US states it works in.

website.description: The organization's own website. This or ein is required.

person.description: The person who will review the profile and receive the email.

email.description: The person's work email. Kindora sends the link there.

locale.description: Language of the email and the review page.

person_approved_sending.description: true only after the person has seen this exact brief and said to send it.

name: start_kindora_profile
title: Start Kindora Profile
